name: chrome-devtools-mcp-wrapper
description: MCP proxy wrapper for chrome-devtools-mcp: share one Chrome across MCP clients, with Chrome lifecycle management, tool filtering and anti-detect

scripts.prestart: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['@modelcontextprotocol/sdk', 'playwright'].forEach(m => { if (!fs.existsSync('node_modules/' + m)) { console.error('Missing dependency: ' + m + ' — run npm install'); process.exit(1) } })"
